title: Expansion and industry in the 19th century

atoms.b:
Claiming the “Wild West”
Following its independence, the United States ((expanded)) westward, attracting many European immigrants. The Homestead Act of 1862 allowed them to ((buy)) land cheaply, while Native Americans were violently dispossessed through treaties, ((land_grabbing)), and war, with survivors forced onto ((reservations)). Their ((legal_status)) remained uncertain until the Indian Citizenship Act 1924 granted all Native Americans born in the US citizenship at birth.

atoms.b:
Labour immigration 1840s-1880s
During the US expansion, many ((workers)) moved into cities to meet the growing ((demand)) for industrial jobs. Irish refugees, Southern and Eastern European immigrants, freed Black Americans, and Asian immigrants all contributed to the expanding ((labour_force)). In the 1840s, many Chinese immigrants came to California during the Gold Rush, working in ((mining)), agriculture, and on the Transcontinental Railroad (1863–1869). They faced ((widespread)) discrimination and violent attacks, leading to the Chinese Exclusion Act of 1882, which ((restricted)) Chinese immigration until 1943.

atoms.a: Many Irish and Eastern Europeans moved into growing industrial cities.
US expansion required a large work force which could only be supported by further immigration.
Chinese immigration was supported by the US government.

feedback.wrong: The US restricted Chinese immigration from 1882 until 1943.

atoms.b:
Colonial Expansion in the late 19th century
American ((colonialism)) shaped political and cultural connections between the US and the new territories. In 1848, the US annexed Northern Mexico, leading to 80,000 Mexicans becoming US citizens. After the Spanish-American War in 1898, the US gained ((control)) of the Philippines, Puerto Rico, and Guam, while Hawaii became a US territory during the same year. These territories linked the local ((population)) to the United States, and many people chose to move to the mainland.

atoms.a: The US had no interest in colonialism.

feedback.wrong: The US fought several wars and invested money into colonial expansion.

atoms.a: People from US colonies moved to the colonial mainland.
The US increased in its population through mass immigration and territorial expansion.
